bindings.label: A 20 × 14-cm² unhealed ulcer on the back has persisted for 3 years
The patient is a 30-year-old woman with a 7.5 × 4-cm² patch of healthy skin on the left forearm lacking blistering
Blood cell genotyping revealed compound heterozygous alterations (c.2992 + 2T>G and c.8621-30A>G) at splice sites in COL7A1
Immunofluorescence/electron microscopy of the grafted area shows type VII collagen and anchoring fibrils
Ulcer-margin histopathology for collagen VII and malignant transformation is unavailable
The grafted area with preserved type VII collagen is revertant/unaffected skin in RDEB
The healthy left forearm patch is revertant/unaffected skin in RDEB
